title: Edit translations
intro: Changes go live for everyone as soon as you save, and are proposed to the 3Speak code in a pull request.

notAvailable.title: Translation editor
notAvailable.body: The translation editor is open to invited translators only. You can still help by suggesting fixes on GitHub.

verify.body: Confirm your Hive account to open the editor. Your wallet will ask you to approve a sign-in.

pendingReset: Will go back to the bundled text when you save
resetTitle: Remove the community edit and use the bundled text
fixErrors: Some rows need fixing before you can save. They are marked in red.
partialSaved: Part of your changes were saved. Fix the marked rows and save again.
notSignedIn: Your sign-in could not be confirmed. Sign in again and retry.
rateLimited: Too many saves. Please wait a few minutes.
unsavedConfirm: You have unsaved translations. Leave anyway?

add.title: Add a language
add.codeHint: Two or three lowercase letters (ISO 639), optionally with a region: nl, fil, pt-BR
add.nativeHint: This is what people see in the language menu, e.g. Nederlands
add.invalidCode: Use two or three lowercase letters, optionally with a region (pt-BR).
